tools.name: get_address
tools.description: Bitcoin: Balance and transaction counts. Supports P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR and P2A addresses, and P2PK public keys in hex (33 or 65 bytes).

tools.name: get_address_confirmed_txs
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get the newest confirmed transactions for an address, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most). For pagination, request `get_address_confirmed_txs_after` with the last returned txid.

tools.name: get_address_confirmed_txs_after
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get the next confirmed transactions strictly older than `after_txid`, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most); a txid outside the address's history answers `[]` (Esplora-canonical pagination form, matches mempool.space).

tools.name: get_address_hash_prefix_matches
tools.description: Bitcoin: Find addresses by address type and by the first 1-16 hex nibbles of RapidHash v3 over the raw address payload bytes. Intended for privacy-preserving client-side wallet discovery without sending raw addresses or xpubs. Fetch metadata with `get_address`.

tools.name: get_address_mempool_txs
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get unconfirmed transactions for an address from the mempool, newest first, up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most).

tools.name: get_address_txs
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get transaction history for an address, newest first: up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most), mempool transactions first and confirmed ones filling the rest. To continue, pass the last returned txid as `after_txid`, or request `get_address_confirmed_txs_after` for confirmed history.

tools.name: get_address_utxos
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for an address, including unconfirmed ones; outputs that mempool transactions spend are left out.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Bitcoin: Details of a block by hash: height, time, transaction count, size, weight, and difficulty.

tools.name: get_block_by_timestamp
tools.description: Bitcoin: Find the block with the greatest header timestamp at or before the given UNIX timestamp, choosing the earliest height on ties.

tools.name: get_block_fee_rates_precise
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get block fee rate percentiles (min, 10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th, max) for a time period, each in sat/vB to 3 decimals.

tools.name: get_block_fees
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get average total fees per block for a time period.

tools.name: get_block_hash_by_height
tools.description: Bitcoin: Block hash as plain text.

tools.name: get_block_header
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns the hex-encoded 80-byte block header.

tools.name: get_block_rewards
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get average coinbase reward (subsidy + fees) per block for a time period.

tools.name: get_block_sizes_weights
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get average block sizes and weights for a time period.

tools.name: get_block_status
tools.description: Bitcoin: Whether the block is in the best chain and, if so, its height and the hash of the next block. A block outside the best chain (orphaned or unknown) reports `in_best_chain: false`.

tools.name: get_block_tip_hash
tools.description: Bitcoin: Hash of the latest block.

tools.name: get_block_tip_height
tools.description: Bitcoin: Height of the latest block.

tools.name: get_block_txid
tools.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve a single transaction ID at a specific index within a block. Returns plain text txid.

tools.name: get_block_txs_from_index
tools.description: Bitcoin: Up to 25 transactions starting at `start_index`, a multiple of 25.

tools.name: get_block_v1
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns block details with extras by hash.

tools.name: get_blocks
tools.description: Bitcoin: The last 10 blocks.

tools.name: get_blocks_from_height
tools.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve up to 10 blocks going backwards from the given height. For example, height=100 returns blocks 100, 99, 98, ..., 91. Height=0 returns only block 0. A height past the tip is not found.

tools.name: get_blocks_v1
tools.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve the last 15 blocks with extended data including pool identification and fee statistics.

tools.name: get_blocks_v1_from_height
tools.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve up to 15 blocks with extended data going backwards from the given height: the published blocks among the 15 heights ending at it, so fewer (or none) past the tip.

tools.name: get_cpfp
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns ancestors and descendants for a CPFP (Child Pays For Parent) transaction, including the effective fee rate of the package. A mempool transaction answers its live package; a confirmed one its package among its block's transactions; an unknown transaction, or a confirmed one without r

tools.name: get_difficulty_adjustment
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get current difficulty adjustment progress and estimates.

tools.name: get_difficulty_adjustments_by_period
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get historical difficulty adjustments for a time period.

tools.name: get_fullrbf_replacements
tools.description: Bitcoin: Same response shape as `get_replacements`, but limited to trees where at least one predecessor was non-signaling (full-RBF).

tools.name: get_hashrate_by_period
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get network hashrate and difficulty data for a time period.

tools.name: get_historical_price
tools.description: Bitcoin: Completed four-hour BTC/USD closes, newest first as mempool.space lists them, labeled by interval end, from the first priced interval (2010-08-16). With a UNIX timestamp, returns the latest nonempty completed close at or before it; before the first close returns an empty list. The current p

tools.name: get_mempool
tools.description: Bitcoin: Current mempool backlog: transaction count, total virtual size, total fees, and fee histogram.

tools.name: get_mempool_blocks
tools.description: Bitcoin: Projected blocks for fee estimation, up to eight as mempool.space's. Every block, block 0 the next, is packed as Core's block assembler packs (whole CPFP chunks by feerate, in dependency order, within Core's default weight and sigop budgets), ranked by the node's signed modified fees (inclu

tools.name: get_mempool_recent
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get the last 10 transactions to enter the mempool.

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description: Bitcoin: Block counts and mining shares by time period for one pool.

tools.name: get_pool_blocks
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get up to 100 recent blocks mined by a specific pool.

tools.name: get_pool_blocks_from_height
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get up to 100 blocks mined by a specific pool strictly below the given height (pass the last height of a page to get the next one).

tools.name: get_pool_hashrate
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get hashrate history for a specific mining pool.

tools.name: get_pool_ranking
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get mining pool statistics for a time period.

tools.name: get_pools
tools.description: Bitcoin: Every known mining pool.

tools.name: get_pools_hashrate_by_period
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get weekly hashrate data, for a time period, of the mining pools that mined in the last week, by time and then their weekly rank.

tools.name: get_precise_fees
tools.description: Bitcoin: Recommended fee rates by confirmation target, with up to three decimal places and support for sub-sat/vB rates.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns bitcoin latest price (on-chain derived, USD only).

tools.name: get_replacements
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns up to 25 most-recent RBF replacement trees across the whole mempool. Each entry has the shape of `replacements` in `get_tx_rbf`.

tools.name: get_reward_stats
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get mining reward statistics for the last N blocks including total rewards, fees, and transaction count.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Bitcoin: History of an on-chain metric, by the series id from `search_series`: rows selected by a range of positions, dates or timestamps, as JSON or CSV.

tools.name: get_series_bulk
tools.description: Bitcoin: Fetch multiple series in a single request. Supports filtering by index and date range. Returns an array of SeriesData objects. For a single series, use `get_series` instead.

tools.name: get_series_count
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns the number of series available per index type.

tools.name: get_series_info
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns the optional description, supported indexes, the indexes whose values can be null, the value type, the optional unit (what the value type measures), and the accumulation (how its values combine over time) of the specified series. The decoded series name is limited to 1024 UTF-8 byte

tools.name: get_series_latest
tools.description: Bitcoin: Current value of an on-chain metric, by the series id from `search_series`. Returns the value alone, not inside a SeriesData object.

tools.name: get_series_len
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get series data length

tools.name: get_series_version
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns the vector's schema/computation version, not its length or latest update. Appends and reorgs do not by themselves change this version.

tools.name: get_sync_status
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns a coherent local index snapshot and a separately observed Bitcoin Core tip height. The two heights can differ during indexing or a reorg. Conditional requests refresh these observations before validation.

tools.name: get_transaction_times
tools.description: Bitcoin: First-seen UNIX timestamps in seconds, in request order, of transactions in the mempool or that recently left it other than by replacement (mined ones included); 0 otherwise.

tools.name: get_tx
tools.description: Bitcoin: Full details of a transaction by txid: inputs, outputs, fee, size, and confirmation status.

tools.name: get_tx_hex
tools.description: Bitcoin: Hex-encoded serialized transaction.

tools.name: get_tx_merkle_proof
tools.description: Bitcoin: Merkle inclusion proof of a confirmed transaction in its block.

tools.name: get_tx_merkleblock_proof
tools.description: Bitcoin: Get the merkleblock proof for a transaction (BIP37 format, hex encoded).

tools.name: get_tx_outspend
tools.description: Bitcoin: Whether the output has been spent and, if so, the spending transaction details. An output no known transaction holds is unspent.

tools.name: get_tx_outspends
tools.description: Bitcoin: Spend statuses in output-index order.

tools.name: get_tx_rbf
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns the RBF replacement tree for a transaction, if any. Both `replacements` and `replaces` are null when the tx has no known RBF history within the mempool monitor's retention window. A history past 63 versions or 4,096 transactions comes cut to its newest part, its root marked `"trunca

tools.name: get_tx_status
tools.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve the confirmation status of a transaction. Returns whether the transaction is confirmed and, if so, the block height, hash, and timestamp. A transaction not in the chain, pending or unknown, is `{"confirmed":false}`.

tools.name: get_txid_by_index
tools.description: Bitcoin: Retrieve the transaction ID (txid) at a given global transaction index. Returns the txid as plain text.

tools.name: get_urpd
tools.description: Bitcoin: URPD (UTXO realized price distribution: how much supply last moved at each price) for a cohort at a block height or the last block of a UTC day. Returns `{ height, hash, date, cohort, weight, aggregation, close, supply, buckets }` where `buckets` is columns, `{ price, supply, realized_cap,

tools.name: get_urpd_latest
tools.description: Bitcoin: URPD (UTXO realized price distribution: how much supply last moved at each price) for the latest published block; `date` echoes the date served. Fields, units, price-grid rounding and weighting as in `get_urpd`.

tools.name: get_utxo_set_diff
tools.description: Bitcoin: What a block (`840000`) or a UTC day's published blocks (`YYYY-MM-DD`) changed in the UTXO set. Returns `{ first, last, hash, date, created, spent }`: `created` has one row per block, `spent` one row per creation height, each as columnar `height`, `count` and `supply` (BTC). The set after b

tools.name: list_indexes
tools.description: Bitcoin: Returns every index a series can be read at, by the name series routes take.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: Bitcoin: Paginated flat list of all available series names.

tools.name: list_urpd_cohorts
tools.description: Bitcoin: Every URPD cohort once a UTXO set is published (none before): the age aggregates (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...), then the age bands from the youngest (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Bitcoin: Find on-chain metrics by plain words: MVRV, realized price, SOPR, NUPL, supply held by long-term or short-term holders, coin age, addresses by balance, hashrate, fees, volume, and thousands more. Start here for any metric question: it returns the series ids to pass to `get_series_latest` or

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Bitcoin: Validate a Bitcoin address and get information about its type and scriptPubKey. Returns `isvalid: false` with an error message for invalid addresses; a string that isn't 2 to 130 letters and digits answers 400.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_urpd" is 944 chars, far longer than this server's median (120). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Bitcoin: URPD (UTXO realized price distribution: how much supply last moved at each price) for a cohort at a block height or the last block of a UTC day. Return…
